channel.title: Preview on Sujith Quintelier
channel.description: Recent content in Preview on Sujith Quintelier

item.title: dotnet: Introducing DocumentExtractionClient (preview): Extract documents in .NET
item.description:
Microsoft introduced DocumentExtractionClient, a preview .NET API for extracting structured content from PDFs, images, and other documents. The initial release includes starter providers to choose from.

  • Source: .NET

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Central governance of hosted-agent outbound domains in Foundry Agent Service
item.description:
Azure Policy can now govern outbound destinations for hosted agents in Foundry Agent Service. Agent authors must attach a compliant egress policy before creating an agent version, and that policy controls outbound requests.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Retirement: Azure AI Content Safety selected features will be retired on April 30, 2027
item.description:
Azure AI Content Safety will retire several preview capabilities on April 30, 2027. The retired items include Analyze Multimodal, custom categories (rapid) for text and image, and connected/disconnected containers for Text, Image, and Prompt Shields.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Limited Preview: Azure Workload Center for SAP and Azure Copilot Run SAP Agent
item.description:
Azure Workload Center for SAP is now available in limited preview, paired with Azure Copilot Run SAP Agent. The feature provides a workload-aware experience for operating SAP on Azure, powered by Workload Virtual Instance (WVI).

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Limited Preview: Azure Workload Center for Oracle and Azure Copilot Run Oracle Agent
item.description:
Azure Workload Center for Oracle and the Azure Copilot Run Oracle Agent are in preview as a workload-aware experience for operating Oracle workloads on Azure. The feature is powered by Workload Virtual Instance (WVI).

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In development] Private Preview: Azure DH/EHasv8 VMs based on 6th Gen AMD EPYC™ (“Venice”) processors
item.description:
Azure is previewing new DHasv8, DHalsv8, and EHasv8 virtual machine series powered by 6th Gen AMD EPYC (“Venice”) processors. The announcement says these VMs are aimed at next-generation cloud applications and provide expanded compute.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Scale ExpressRoute Direct connectivity with link groups
item.description:
Azure ExpressRoute Direct now supports link groups in public preview. This lets high-throughput workloads scale connectivity by aggregating links, reducing the need to manage multiple independent ExpressRoute connections.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Monitor traces and Trace Analytics
item.description:
Azure Monitor traces is now in public preview, adding dedicated trace analysis in Application Insights. It lets you analyze and compare large volumes of traces and drill from trends to root cause using distributed tracing.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure SQL updates for mid-November 2026
item.description:
Azure SQL preview updates in mid-November 2026 add new SSMS Create and Apply wizards for working with .dacpac and .bacpac files. These wizards consolidate and replace the older workflow for creating and applying these package files.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Network Watcher Private Link support
item.description:
Azure Network Watcher VNet Flow Logs in preview now support flow log enrichment for Azure Private Link Service. This adds more visibility into traffic flowing through Private Link Service by retaining backend flow details.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: New integration, hybrid deployment, and observability capabilities in Azure Logic Apps
item.description:
Azure Logic Apps added preview capabilities for enterprise integration, hybrid deployment, and observability. The update is aimed at running workflows across cloud and on-premises environments and modernizing legacy integrations.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: OS-level dependency support via containers for Azure Functions Flex Consumption
item.description:
Azure Functions Flex Consumption now has preview support for OS-level dependencies via containers. This lets apps extend the Microsoft-managed worker environment with native executables and system libraries.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Policy support for Azure HorizonDB
item.description:
Azure Policy support for Azure HorizonDB is now available in preview. A new built-in policy can automatically deploy diagnostic settings to help apply governance and observability standards across HorizonDB deployments.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Limited Preview: Compute templates for Azure
item.description:
Azure has introduced a limited preview of compute templates, which let customers define, version, and reuse standardized VM configurations across deployments. The feature is aimed at simplifying virtual machine configuration management.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Backup for PostgreSQL flexible server and elastic cluster (v2)
item.description:
Azure Backup for PostgreSQL flexible server and elastic cluster (v2) is now in preview. It uses physical backups from managed disk snapshots and stores them in an Azure Backup vault for long-term retention.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Performance monitoring for Azure Arc–enabled SQL Server
item.description:
The public preview for performance monitoring of Azure Arc–enabled SQL Server adds more flexible ways to explore and visualize performance data. Users can query Microsoft-managed monitoring data directly through a telemetry endpoint.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Introducing a Guided Copilot Experience for Building Azure Apps in VS Code
item.description:
Microsoft is previewing a guided Copilot experience in VS Code for building Azure apps. It provides a structured workflow that helps move from idea to deployed app instead of relying on a free-form chat session.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Multicloud Interconnect
item.description:
Azure Multicloud Interconnect is now in public preview. It provides managed private connectivity between Azure and supported cloud providers, with AWS as the first provider available in preview.

  • Source: Azure Updates
